description: Keyword search across all served DVSA recalls (make, model names, concern, defect and remedy text), newest first, optionally since a date. Text is English ("airbag", "fire", "steering rack", "takata", "high voltage battery"); every word must appear. Suited to cross-make questions such as recent EV battery fire recalls in the UK.

since.description: optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — only recalls launched on/after it

text.description: words that must all appear, e.g. "airbag takata"

name: uk_recalls_search
title: UK recalls search
